messages:
Harper: beginning staged rollout v2026.04.20-rc2 -> 20% global (na, eu, ap split). Change window 01:30-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/v2026.04.20-rc2
DeployBot: deploy started id=sr-176777 target=20% regions=[na,eu,ap] strategy=split-percent
Ken: +1. I'll watch latency and error budget. Can we enable region pinning if needed?
Maya: yes, rollouts support per-region pause/pin. Commands: ``/deploy pause sr-176777 --region <region>`` and ``/deploy pin sr-176777 --region <region> --variant <ver>``
SRE-Oncall: adding kv-cache and 95p latency panels. Monitoring.
Harper: at 6m in, ap region 95p jumped 70ms->260ms. No 5xxs but tail spikes affecting a small customer cohort.
Ken: pause ap only. ``/deploy pause sr-176777 --region ap``
DeployBot: acknowledged: paused sr-176777 for region ap. status: ap=0%, na+eu=20% global~13.3%
InfraBot: ap pinned to v2026.04.18-stable to prevent customer impact.
SRE-Oncall: traces show adapter init + image pull slow on a new node pool in ap. Recommend prewarm + PREFETCH=1 for ap before resuming.
Maya: agree. Who will run warmup? Ken can you run prewarm and toggle prefetch?
Ken: running: ``infra/prewarm --region ap --model rc2 && infra/flag set PREFETCH=1 --region ap``
DeployBot: prewarm job started job=prewarm-176777-ap
Ken: prewarm complete. PREFETCH=1 set. kv-hit improved 0.4->0.9. Ready to resume with cautious ramp 2%->10%->20% over 3m intervals.
Harper: resume with that ramp. ``/deploy resume sr-176777 --region ap --ramp 2,10,20 --interval 3m``
DeployBot: resuming sr-176777: ap ramp=2%->10%->20% intervals=3m; na+eu unchanged
SRE-Oncall: monitoring kv-miss-rate and 95p in ap. Will escalate on threshold.
Maya: good work. Keep the rollback shortcut handy: ``/deploy rollback sr-176777``. Leaving regional pin for 45m in case of regression.
DeployBot: rollout active sr-176777 -> 20% global. Temporary flags auto-expire in 60m.
Harper: LGTM. I'll watch for 45m then clean up temp alerts.
